verdict.rationale: Vanta supports webhooks for real-time event notifications and an API to build custom automations/tests, which could be chained into rule-like triggers, but there is no evidence of a native rule-builder or 'if event X then action Y' automation engine that an AI-native user could define declaratively. missing for 10: a documented rules/trigger engine or workflow builder, examples of user-defined conditional automations, and independent confirmation of event-driven action execution beyond webhooks.
